lineage.strategy: Corroborate the independent Berlin-factory signal with Planet's own dated operational account while preserving capacity-utilization uncertainty.

observations.fact: Planet states its Berlin facility is scheduled to open this fall and will add satellite manufacturing to its existing European engineering, mission-operations, data and business functions for the first time.

Planet traces its German operating base to the 2015 RapidEye acquisition, indicating the new manufacturing site extends an established regional operating footprint rather than creating one from scratch.

risks.risk: A scheduled opening and established regional footprint do not prove production ramp, utilization, delivery cadence or profitable satellite economics.

unknowns.unknown: Issuer material does not establish realized Berlin output, unit cost, margin contribution or signed demand sufficient to absorb capacity.

recommendation: Use as primary corroboration of European manufacturing execution; retain utilization and economics as explicit underwriting unknowns.
